name: Inoculate
placementTarget: Back of each player reference card
text:
INOCULATE (FREE ACTION)
Take a Player card or an Infection card matching your current city from its discard pile. Put it into Package 6.

mechanics.effect: Take a Player card or an Infection card matching your current city from its discard pile and put it into Package 6.
restrictions: The card must match your current city
The card comes from that deck's discard pile
mechanics.notes: Reference overlay. Sticker 02 says to place it on the back of each player reference card. The storage limits and the look-but-don't-sticker rule are on Rule I, not on this overlay.
